Title: TOM: Q: DS: Riposte and Dawn Op

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Tom,

Does the one point of damage done by Riposte become
Aggravated during a Dawn Operation?

My immediate thought was 'yes' because Riposte is a
combat card, but then I noticed that the damage seemed
to be done after combat was over (since it may not
be prevented), and therefore outside the scope of
Dawn Op.

What's the official take on this?
